mentions.title: King main bearings setting up loose?
mentions.snippet: Builder reports King main bearings setting up loose on assembly. Search results returned this alongside reports of out-of-spec 'free spread' on King main bearings; the free-spread detail is attributed to the result set, not read in-thread.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: An explicit buyer-warning thread telling builders to measure every King bearing before installing it. Warning-style titles aimed at other buyers are the most damaging format for the brand.
mentions.replyNote: Still returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; thread content could not be read.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread about King main thrust bearings; the poster ended up sourcing NOS Clevite thrust bearings and reported those measured in spec. Still open with no King reply.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully again: no King or official reply, thread still open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports NOS Clevite thrust bearings measured in spec.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Reports King STDX thrust bearings measuring over 1mm too narrow to fit BMW S85 and S65 blocks, with more than one block showing the same result. A dimensional defect claim, not an install error.
mentions.replyNote: Still 307-redirects to the tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning thread content; redirect not followed.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: A customer reports receiving a sealed package with the wrong mix of bearing sizes and criticises the support he got resolving it. Complaint is about service response as much as the part.
mentions.replyNote: Still returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; thread content could not be read.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: One shell in a King SI main set arrived crushed and twisted and out of size; the poster also reports machining shavings in the rod bearing packaging. Single credible defect report, no King reply.
mentions.replyNote: Thread read successfully; no King or official brand representative has replied and it remains open and unresolved.
